name: Synthwave
eras: genre coalesced c. 2006–2011 online; visual style evokes 1980–89
garments: not primarily a fashion look — a music and graphic-design aesthetic
reacts_against: nothing contemporaneous — it's a retrofuturist revival of 1980s synthesizer music and VHS-era graphic design, built decades after the fact.
revivals: ongoing; the core aesthetic of the genre since its 2000s-10s formation

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Neon grids, wireframe landscapes, striped sunsets, 1980s supercars (Testarossa, Countach), palm trees, VHS tracking static, chrome typography
wiki_facts.key_colours: Magenta, cyan, violet, neon pink, deep blue, black
